sentences.text: Marine Software Solutions Ab is a newly registered company, entered in the register on 2026-10-02 under the industry code 58290, other software publishing.
A start-up notification and a board change were both registered on 2026-10-14.
No grant, EU project, public contract or funding record is on file, so only the first business level is read.
For the fund this is a watchlist case, and the record does not yet show what the software does or whether it has an ocean use.
